rules: One executable node or gate owns one cohesive responsibility.
Several deterministic commands may remain in one RUN node only when they produce one cohesive evidence report.
A blocking deterministic decision is RUN -> evidence -> mechanical GATE.
A node must not hardcode PASS for quality/readiness status fields.
Materialization, validation, and handoff are separate responsibilities.
Multiway semantic routing may remain a node when binary GATE semantics are insufficient.
Generated runnable playbooks inherit this policy through PLAYBOOK_LAWS.md and Vibe authoring behavior.
